name: Coal Light-oil Recovery
mechanism: Capture coke-making byproduct streams and separate a light aromatic fraction from other condensates and gas.
operating_requirement: Pay suitable coal, capture and separation equipment, cooling, heat and work; conserve paid coal across coke and recovered fractions with unrecovered residues.
consequence: Supply a qualified aromatic feed to known chemical processing; ordinary stored coke cannot retroactively produce byproducts and a mixed light oil is not every pure aromatic.
branching_note: These are selected game production pathways, not claims that other historical implementations are impossible. All listed foundations apply; knowledge never supplies equipment or materials.
recovery: Acquire attributable coal light-oil recovery instruction or working samples, then pay for local setup and acceptance trials.

recovery_contract.local_demonstration: Capture coke-making byproduct streams and separate a light aromatic fraction from other condensates and gas.
recovery_contract.operating_requirements: Pay suitable coal, capture and separation equipment, cooling, heat and work; conserve paid coal across coke and recovered fractions with unrecovered residues.

route_terms.scholar_envoy: Pay a reachable specialist, travel, consumable practice stock and supervised local coal light-oil recovery trials.
route_terms.partnership: Share actual samples and operator time for coal light-oil recovery; independently inspect the partner output.
route_terms.purchased_research: Fund a bounded coal light-oil recovery process trial with recorded materials, failures and output checks.
route_terms.licensed_or_imported_service: Pay for finite external coal light-oil recovery processing; delivered material does not grant local manufacture.
route_terms.reverse_engineering: Inspect an attributable coal light-oil recovery machine or processed sample and pay to reproduce its result; hidden settings may prevent success.

implementation_status: Authored proposal only. Promotion requires paid capital, actual typed feed and output lots, finite work/energy/material accounting, quality failures, saved partial state and the downstream consumer described above. Neither a catalog row nor a global percentage bonus establishes operation.
historical_scope: H04 classifies this chosen operational capability, not an invention date or calendar unlock. Sources support the short mechanism description; game prerequisites, named ledger states and acceptance contracts are design inferences.

name: Isocyanate Synthesis
mechanism: Convert a defined amine with separately prepared industrial carbonylation feeds into the selected isocyanate product and separate residual material.
operating_requirement: Pay named amine and compatible carbonylation inputs, contained conversion and cooling capacity, separation, quality checks and residue handling; retain finite yield and losses.
consequence: Supply a specified isocyanate to a known polyaddition process with its compatible polyol; it is not a universal monomer or finished polyurethane by itself.
